definitions.explanation: A pricing system in which the manufacturer sets the retail price and retailers cannot discount it. In Japan, this is legally permitted for certain categories such as books, newspapers, and music CDs.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The resale price maintenance system applies to books.

examples.japanese: {再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{新刊書|しんかんしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値引|ねび}き→値引き：05424_nebiki⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the resale price maintenance system, new books are not discounted.

examples.japanese: {出版業界|しゅっぱんぎょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In the publishing industry, debate continues over whether to abolish the resale price maintenance system.

notes:
Short for {再販売|さいはんばい}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (resale-price maintenance system). Compound of {再販|さいはん} (resale) + ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (system).

USAGE:
In most industries, manufacturers in Japan cannot dictate the retail price under antitrust law. The {再販制度|さいはんせいど} is a legal exception that covers a small set of cultural goods (books, newspapers, magazines, music CDs), partly to protect small bookstores and ensure uniform availability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧: the system applies
- {再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧: abolition of the system
- {再販制度|さいはんせいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: an item covered by the system
